source.title: Clogher Rural District, "Notice of Result of Elections: Election of Rural District Councillors for the above-named Rural District in the Year 1911", dated 26 May 1911, Claude C. Hamilton, returning officer (PRONI LA/24/3/AD/1; the owner's photographs of 10 November 2026, frames 387 and 389)
source.publisher: Public Record Office of Northern Ireland (Clogher Rural District Council records)
source.check: read from the owner's photographs of the printed notice in two blind transcriptions by separate readers, which agreed on every name, figure and mark; a script checked that each division elects as many as its seats and that the elected are the top of the poll; abodes are not published

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, held with the election of the board of guardians: each district electoral division returned its councillors, who were also its guardians. Polled Thursday 25 May 1911 ("Polling took place throughout the greater part of Co. Tyrone to-day (Thursday)": Tyrone Constitution, 26 May 1911, p. 5); counted and declared in the union boardroom on Friday 26 May. Errigal returned 2 councillors, unopposed.
